verdict.rationale: IP India is a government IP office with public search and e-filing portals, so an interactive API reference is a fair question for this kind of product. The evidence shows only web portals for search, filing, status tracking and publications, and the llms.txt probe returned 404. Nothing documents an API reference, let alone one with runnable examples.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
